feed.subtitle: Announcements and milestones from the Center for AI in Knowledge Institutions at CU Boulder.

entry.title: AIKI is hiring a postdoctoral associate for a two-year appointment starting in 2027. Research areas include language models as stand-ins for human participants, AI and culture, the science of science, and language and social reasoning. Apply by January 15, 2027, for full consideration. Read the posting and apply.
